note: Dutch or French were observed required at some boutique consulting firms even for internationally-facing roles.
Fluent Spanish was observed as a near-systematic requirement, including at companies with international operations.
Searching in French for generalist strategy/right-hand-to-CEO roles ('bras droit CEO') returned more junior results than searching the English equivalent.

Several large-employer graduate programmes in public affairs/communications (e.g. strategy consulting, telecom external affairs, PR) were observed paying below the general GBP 41,700 Skilled Worker threshold and/or explicitly stating they do not sponsor a visa.

Skilled Worker visa general salary threshold is GBP 41,700/year. A 'new entrant' exception (under 26, or recent graduate within a few years of completion) lowers the threshold to roughly GBP 33,400/year.

The market for junior generalist strategy/operations roles ('founder's associate' type) was observed to be thin; postings under that heading are frequently internships rather than permanent contracts.
The market was observed as nascent, with most postings either startup-technical or senior; low overall volume.

A LinkedIn posting's publish date and application-click counter (0 clicks is a strong signal) help identify stale postings; a match found only through a third-party aggregator should be cross-checked on the employer's own careers page, since aggregators can keep indexing a posting after it has been withdrawn at the source.
'GTM' appearing in a Chief of Staff title was observed to correlate with a sales/revenue-focused role rather than a generalist strategy role.

Postings titled 'Junior', 'Associate' or 'Founder's Associate' were repeatedly found to carry real experience requirements of 1-5 years in the body of the listing, sometimes hidden in JavaScript-rendered sections (e.g. a 'Non-Negotiables' block) not returned by a simple page fetch. A rendered-browser read of the full posting is needed before classifying a title as entry-level.

Some 'AI strategy' or 'AI business consulting' graduate postings carry a hidden gate requiring a technical Master's degree (computer science, engineering, data science) plus a named programming stack (Python, R, SQL, Java), despite a generalist-sounding title.
